newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - Gas oil rises, gasoline may bounc.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - Gas oil rises, gasoline may bounc.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday morning, with gasoline and fuel oil weaker while gas oil gained, dealers said.
Gasoline suffered from the one cent a gallon fall of NYMEX unleaded futures on Tuesday, but seemed set to strengthen with some recovery expected on Wednesday.
Two Eurograde barges traded at $197 fob AR, one for the first half of May, the other for the whole of May. The trades represented a weakness of about $1 a tonne.
Heating oil barges gained as IPE gas oil futures improved. Offers remained at IPE May +$1 fob Rotterdam or +25/+50 cents fob Antwerp.
Some German traders said end consumer demand had improved slightly, but low Rhine water levels limited trading prospects.
High sulphur fuel oil was around $1 a tonne lower. By late morning only one barge had traded, at $83 fob Rotterdam. Traders said there were hardly any buyers.
Bunker demand appeared low despite two larger sized enquiries.
